issue_context.title: Remove gulp-transform dependency
issue_context.body:
It appears gulp-transform has been abandoned by the author and it contains a dependency on an old version of gulp-util which has a critical security vulnerability. I don't think the vulnerability is actually an issue for our use, but it would be nice to have a clean audit of the pdf.js deps. 

I think we could replace it with something like https://gist.github.com/CITguy/079c631ac5f181939e08
comments: @Snuffleupagus or @timvandermeij any interest in taking this on?
@0x15F9 Yes, please feel free to work on this.
In which folder to I need to add the custom code to replace gulp-transform?

I would put it in the `gulpfile.js` file itself since it's stand-alone and the replacement code should be very small. You can test your changes by running the commands that use `gulp-transform` before and after your patch and asserting that they produce the same files/changes.
I am unable to figure the purpose of line 13 in myTransform.js at https://gist.github.com/CITguy/079c631ac5f181939e08 . Could you  help me out?

The comment states that `contents can only be a Buffer, Stream, or null`, so this line sets the contents of the new file. Basically, the transform function takes one file and transforms it to another file. My advice is to first look at how we use the `gulp-transform` package so the example of `myTransform` becomes more clear.
@0x15F9 are you still working on this?
Hi. I would like to work on this issue? Is it still open?
Hi, Is the issue still open?

It doesn't look like @0x15F9 is still working on this, so since @MrNoddyInfy was the next to ask they can work on it. If they cannot work on it, @smohtadi can, et cetera. Please comment here if you cannot work on it so the next one can take it.
@timvandermeij you can assign it to anyone else interested since I am not looking into this.
@MrNoddyInfy Thank you for letting us know. @smohtadi Are you interested in picking this up?

Hi @timvandermeij, I'm planning to create a custom transform module that takes in a function and follows the logic on example provided above.
I'm wondering if you have any preference as to the location of this file.
Since the transform function should be small, I would suggest to put it in the Gulpfile so it's self-contained.

review_comments:
If this patch works it's by luck alone, since you must add the [through2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/through2) package to the https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/package.json file (and then run `npm install` locally, such that the https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/package-lock.json file is updated as well) for this to actually be correct.

*Edit:* And also remove the `gulp-transform` entry from the `package.json` file, given that it should no longer be used.
